label: Floodlights (electric)
description: Electric floodlights. Computes annual tCO2e from installed power and average daily usage.

inputs.label: Total installed power
inputs.help: Sum of floodlight power (all lamps combined).

inputs.label: Average daily usage
inputs.help: Average hours of use per day (use seasonal average if applicable).

inputs.label: Electricity carbon intensity
inputs.help: Grid carbon intensity used to convert kWh into emissions.
